author.pt-BR: São Luís Maria Grignion de Montfort

description.fr-FR: Huit lettres de saint Louis-Marie (à son directeur M. Léchassier et à sa sœur Louise, religieuse du Saint-Sacrement), et son Testament de 1716, telles que les cite Pauvert dans sa Vie du vénérable L.-M. Grignion de Montfort (1875).
description.en-US: Eight letters of St. Louis-Marie (to his director M. Léchassier and to his sister Louise, a Blessed Sacrament nun) and his Testament of 1716, as quoted in Pauvert’s Life of the Venerable L.-M. Grignion de Montfort (1875).
description.pt-BR: Oito cartas de são Luís Maria (a seu diretor M. Léchassier e à sua irmã Luísa, religiosa do Santíssimo Sacramento) e seu Testamento de 1716, tais como as cita Pauvert na Vida do venerável L.-M. Grignion de Montfort (1875).

sources.edition: C. Pauvert, Vie du vénérable Louis-Marie Grignion de Montfort, Poitiers: Oudin, 1875; archive.org OCR, letters and Testament extracted from the narrative.
sources.description: Only the letters and the Testament that Pauvert prints in full are extracted (8 of the 34 known letters). OCR cleaned by script; Pauvert’s 19th-century readings of the autographs may differ from the critical text.
sources.tierEvidence: Montfort d. 1716; the 1875 life is public domain.

title.fr-FR: Lettres citées dans la Vie de Pauvert
